operator_assessment.operator_summary: Kongsberg U9's middle tournament (rvv-0156, Tønsberg-hosted) was moved from 2027-02-21 to 2027-03-13, spreading the 3-tournament, 8-day cluster (Feb 20/21/28) into a more even Feb 20 -> Feb 28 -> Mar 13 spacing. The move was hard-verified (no arena/roster/holiday conflicts) and required no roster swap. The plan remains usable for this age group; the rest of the season's known review items are pre-existing and untouched by this change.

key_tradeoffs.title: Single targeted move, no broader replan
key_tradeoffs.summary: Only rvv-0156's date was changed; unrelated tournaments and all approvals/locks were preserved.

remaining_actions.title: Tønsberg reconfirm ice for new date
remaining_actions.summary: Tønsberg should confirm Tønsberghallen availability for 2027-03-13 with the club/arena before this is treated as booked.

remaining_actions.title: Pre-existing season-wide REVIEW_REQUIRED items remain open
remaining_actions.summary: Hosting balance imbalances, participation shortfalls/deviations, unresolved external conflicts, and a movable-capacity host confirmation are unrelated to this move and still need normal season-maintenance attention.

limitations: This audit focused on the changed tournament and export consistency rather than re-auditing the full season from scratch; season-wide findings are carried forward from deterministic evidence, not independently re-derived here.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: Not affected by this change; no new cup-count issues introduced by the rvv-0156 move.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: rvv-0156 remains a Tønsberg-hosted home tournament for Tønsberg U9; hosting responsibility unchanged by the move.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: Tournament length/game count for rvv-0156 unchanged by the date-only move.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: Verified: 2027-03-13 Tønsberghallen is free of other bookings; the new date passed hard arena/capacity verification.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar vertsklubben i samme turnering?
checklist_findings.finding: Host club Tønsberg participates in rvv-0156 at its new date, as before.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: No team plays twice on 2027-03-13 among affected teams; verified by the hard verifier on both dry-run and apply.

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: Max 2 teams from any one club at rvv-0156 (Holmen has 2); unchanged by the move.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: Export format consistency check (csv/ical/excel row counts) matches plan post-export; no mismatches reported.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministic verify: ok=true, zero hard violations. Pre-existing season-wide REVIEW_REQUIRED reasons (hosting_balance_imbalances=12, participation_shortfalls=100, participation_target_deviation=23, tournament_placement_shortfall=12, external_calendar_conflicts=3, movable_host_confirmation_required=1) are unrelated to this targeted move and were already present before it; this change neither introduces nor resolves them.
